topic: Claude Code for non-coders: pick up exactly where you left off, without re-explaining everything
post:
Closed Claude Code halfway through a project, and dreading explaining it all again? 😩
You don't have to. You can pick up right where you left off.

The Claude Code docs say it saves every conversation on your computer. So yesterday's chat is still there. 💾

Two ways back in 👇
1️⃣ Continue the latest one: start Claude Code with claude --continue in the same folder
2️⃣ Choose from a list: type /resume inside Claude Code and pick the conversation you want

(A "command" is just something you type, then press Enter. That's it.)

Then give it a quick nudge:
"Let's keep going. Remind me in 3 bullets where we left off, and what the next step was." ✅

Try it today:
Start a tiny project, like a one-page to-do list. Close Claude Code. Open it again and continue. 🔁

📌 Claude Code is included with Claude's Pro and Max plans.

Why it matters:
Real projects take more than one sitting. Picking up where you left off saves you re-explaining, and keeps Claude on track. 💡

What project would you come back to tomorrow? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.

#Claude #AI #AIForBeginners #ClaudeCode
